description: This source file implements an in-memory pub/sub hub for handling WebSocket connections in a FastAPI application. It manages subscriptions to delivery IDs, allows publishing messages to subscribed WebSockets, and handles unsubscriptions and cleanup.

classes.name: Subscription
classes.description: Immutable dataclass representing a subscription with a delivery ID.

classes.name: RealtimeHub
classes.description: In-memory pub/sub hub for managing WebSocket subscriptions and publishing messages.

methods.name: None __init__(self)
methods.description: Initializes the hub with a lock and a dictionary for delivery ID to WebSocket set mapping.

methods.name: None subscribe(self, websocket: WebSocket, delivery_id: UUID)
methods.description: Registers a WebSocket to receive messages for a specific delivery ID.

methods.name: None unsubscribe_all(self, websocket: WebSocket)
methods.description: Removes a WebSocket from all delivery subscriptions, cleaning up empty sets.

methods.name: None publish(self, delivery_id: UUID, message_type: str, payload: dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Publishes a message to all WebSockets subscribed to a given delivery ID, attaching metadata like emitted time.

ctags.name: publish
ctags.pattern: /^    async def publish(self, delivery_id: UUID, message_type: str, payload: dict[str, Any]) -> No/
ctags.signature: (self, delivery_id: UUID, message_type: str, payload: dict[str, Any])

ctags.name: subscribe
ctags.pattern: /^    async def subscribe(self, websocket: WebSocket, delivery_id: UUID) -> None:$/
